---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest new functionality, or propose tackling an item from todo.md
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**Which crate does this belong to?**
`tpt-gis-core` / `tpt-gis-geom` / `tpt-gis-raster` / `tpt-gis-io` / `tpt-gis-index` / other

**Is this already tracked in `todo.md`?**
If yes, link the item. If not, briefly say why it isn't (new scope, not yet reached
in the roadmap, etc).

**Describe what you'd like**
What should the API/behavior look like? A short code sketch helps.

**Why**
What use case does this unblock? (e.g. "needed for GeoPackage support," "needed for
the drone geofence MVP.")

**Constraints**
Anything that matters for this project specifically — e.g. must stay `no_std`,
must not add a GPL/LGPL-licensed dependency, must not require heap allocation.
